title: Shisha Cloudz – Sample Pack 10mL each (5 Flavours)
description:
Shisha Cloudz – Sample Pack 10mL each (5 Flavours)
Shisha Cloudz E-Liquid sample box features five different shisha flavours. If you love shisha flavoured vape juice and want to try all the popular flavours, then this sample vape juice box is a perfect choice.
It Comes With:
Double Apple:
Take your taste buds through an explosion of Green and Red apples, intertwining and entangling with joy on the taste buds!
A serious Shisha classic!
Grape Raspberry
Sweet purple grapes have been smashed with lashings of fresh raspberries to create this spellbindingly good Shisha vape!
An OG in the Shisha flavour scene!
Ice Lemon
Lemonade. Crunchy Ice. Beat it once. Beat it Twice! Freeze!
An Original Icy Citrus Shisha flavour!
Mango Grape
Sweet sweet mangoes and purple grapes with original Shisha notes make this a flavour banger you have to have in your vape rotation!
Menthol
This flavour packs a seriously minty menthol explosion followed by an icy blast that leaves a cooling sensation tingling on the taste buds!
